title: The Dark Truth About Venus Versus Virus #Shorts
description:
What culture calls destiny in Venus Versus Virus is usually just selection pressure wearing a suit. Venus Versus Virus (ヴィーナス ヴァーサス ヴァイアラス, Vīnasu Vāsasu Vaiarasu) is a Japanese manga series created by Atsushi Suzumi which was first serialized on June 27, 2005, in MediaWorks' shōnen manga magazine Dengeki Comic Gao!. The manga ended serialization in Dengeki Comic Gao! on February 27, 2008, due to the magazine's discontinuation, but the manga continued serialization in ASCII Media Works' manga magazine Dengeki Daioh between March 21 and July 26, 2008.

The nihilist does not deny Venus Versus Virus — he only refuses to flatter it. MVM Entertainment released the TV series on region 2 DVD on May 30, 2022, in the original NTSC format, in the UK. The anime's opening theme is "Bravin' Bad Brew" by Riryka, and the ending theme is "Shijun no Zankoku" by Yousei Teikoku.
